DEMO STUDIO / CASH APPLICATION · AI CUSTOMER IDENTIFICATION

Autonomous Lockbox Agent

A customer-identification and cash-application agent design that combines bank receipts, remittance evidence and SAP open items, with explicit exception routing.

← All demos
In development · Design & prototype
SAP S/4HANABAI2ISO 20022AI agentsSAP Joule

BEFORE

Payments arrive with partial payer and invoice detail. Analysts reconcile BAI2 lockbox files, remittance emails and SAP open items by hand, and the exception queue keeps growing.

AFTER

An agent reads remittance evidence from BAI2 and ISO 20022 data, identifies the customer, and proposes invoice matches with its reasoning. Ambiguous cases go to an analyst, and policy thresholds limit automated posting.

The business problem

Cash arrives with incomplete payer and invoice information. Finance teams must reconcile fragmented bank files, remittances and SAP records.

Value to evaluate

Designed to support more consistent matching decisions and reduce analyst investigation. Operational results have not yet been measured.

Controls & accountability

The design separates master-data changes, sends ambiguous matches to review, checks duplicates and limits automated posting through policy thresholds.

Project evidence & maturity

Local design pack with 14 illustrative scenarios, architecture notes, guardrails and a workbench mockup. Confidence scores are illustrative; this is not a production deployment.

REFERENCE APPROACH

From information
to an accountable decision.

  1. 01Bank receipts, BAI2 & ISO 20022 remittances
  2. 02SAP customer & open-item evidence
  3. 03Customer identification, matching & policy checks
  4. 04Analyst review or controlled posting
